parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of incomplete results depending on the order of symbols with permute=True. It introduces a more comprehensive approach to handle permutations and signed permutations.

issues.description: The code could be more readable by adding comments to explain the logic of handling permutations and signed permutations.
The code style could be improved to match the project's conventions, such as consistent indentation and spacing.
